name: Aisling general calendar
description:
The average calendar used in Aislings known world
The year is 360 days long and there are 9 months with 5 weeks each consisting of 8 days

months.name: Emergence
months.desc: The first month of the year, as life begins to stir from the chill of Solitude. The snow begins to recede, and the first green shoots appear. It's a time of renewal and the start of the planting season. The moon is becoming more visible day by day.

months.name: Bloom
months.desc: The month where the world truly begins to wake up from its winter slumber. Flowers burst forth in a riot of colors, and the landscape is filled with the sound of nesting birds. The moon is now clearly visible in the sky.

months.name: Solstice
months.desc: The start of the warm season, where the days are longest and the nights shortest. This is a time of growth and vigor, as crops planted in Emergence shoot up towards the sky. The moon is reaching its peak luminosity.

months.name: Luminara
months.desc: This month is the peak of summer, characterized by long, warm days and short nights. This is a time of abundance and celebration. The moon remains bright and visible as it is at its most luminous.

months.name: Harvest
months.desc: As the heat of Luminara wanes, the crops ripen, and the world prepares for the harvest. This month is marked by the gathering of grains and celebration of plenty. The moon's visibility begins to gradually decrease.

months.name: Fall
months.desc: The world begins to cool, leaves start to change color and fall, and the year's labors come to fruition. This is a time of gratitude and preparation for the coming chill. The moon is now less visible.

months.name: Eclipse
months.desc: The chill deepens, and the world begins its retreat into the quiet of winter. The month is characterized by early frosts and the preparation of preserved foods for winter. The moon is hardly visible.

months.name: Wane
months.desc: The cold of winter truly sets in. This month is characterized by short days and long nights, and the landscape is often covered with snow. The moon begins to wax again, marking the return of light and hope.

months.name: Solitude
months.desc: The final month of the year, where the world is at its quietest. It's a time of rest and reflection, as life waits beneath the snow for the return of warmth. The moon is becoming clearly visibile now, signaling the end of Solitude and the beginning of a new year with Emergence.

celestials.name: The EverLune
celestials.desc: The major deity residing in the sky above the Known World
